      <title>Salesloft: Principal Software Engineer, AI</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States, Remote
</p>

<p><span><strong>Job Title:</strong> Principal Software Engineer, AI&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span><strong>Location</strong>: Remote - US</span></p>
<p>Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.</p>
<p>With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.</p>
<p>Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.</p>
<p><strong>THE OPPORTUNITY</strong></p>
<p>At Salesloft, our Principal Engineer for AI sets the technical direction for how machine intelligence works across our Predictive Revenue System. This is the most senior individual-contributor role on our AI engineering team: you will architect the systems that turn LLMs, machine learning models, and agentic workflows into production capabilities that thousands of enterprise revenue teams depend on.</p>
<p>This is deep, ambiguous, frontier work. You will make the foundational architectural decisions for AI at Salesloft — how we serve models at scale, how we build reliable systems on top of non-deterministic components, how we evaluate and guardrail agentic behavior, and how we keep pace as the underlying foundation models evolve. You will set the standards other engineers build on and act as a technical multiplier across the AI organization.</p>
<p>On a day-to-day basis, you will:</p>
<ul>
<li>Set the technical architecture and direction for AI systems across the platform — model serving, LLM-powered features, agentic workflows, and the infrastructure beneath them.</li>
<li>Design production-grade systems that are reliable and observable despite being built on non-deterministic, probabilistic AI components.</li>
<li>Architect evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and quality systems that make AI behavior safe, measurable, and trustworthy at enterprise scale.</li>
<li>Lead the most complex AI engineering problems end to end — from research-adjacent prototyping through hardened production delivery.</li>
<li>Establish engineering standards and best practices for building AI-native systems, and mentor senior engineers across the org.</li>
<li>Keep the platform at the frontier by evaluating and integrating advances in foundation models, agent frameworks, and the modern AI stack.</li>
</ul>
<p>This role lives at the heart of how we Lead From the Front: you'll work at the edge of applied AI, prototype rapidly, and make architectural bets ahead of the field. And in the spirit of how we Make Your Mark, you'll set the AI engineering standards and systems that the entire organization builds on — engineered for scale, not for a demo.</p>
<p><strong>WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR</strong></p>
<p>We are looking for an engineer who operates at the highest level of technical authority in AI systems — someone who has architected and shipped production AI at scale and understands the deep challenges of building reliable systems on probabilistic foundations. You lead through technical credibility and make the engineers around you better.</p>
<p>You embody what we call Evidence Over Ego — you make architectural decisions from evaluation data and evidence rather than hype, you invite rigorous challenge, and you change direction when the models or the data move. You bring systems thinking to a genuinely unsolved problem space and build for durability.</p>
<p>This is the right role if you want to define how AI works on a platform at the center of enterprise revenue.</p>
<p><strong>THE TEAM</strong></p>
<p>The Salesloft AI Engineering organization builds the machine intelligence at the core of the Predictive Revenue System. The team works at the intersection of applied research and production engineering, in close partnership with Product, Data Science, and Data Platform Engineering.</p>
<p>The team Moves as One — AI engineering, product, and data science share ownership of shipping trustworthy AI and make hard technical calls together. And we are relentlessly Customer Inspired: every AI capability is measured against whether it makes revenue teams genuinely more successful and more confident in the system.</p>
<p><strong>THE SKILL SET</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Extensive experience building and architecting production software systems at scale, with significant depth in AI/ML systems.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience building production systems on top of LLMs or machine learning models — including designing for the challenges of non-deterministic behavior.</li>
<li>Deep expertise in distributed systems, model serving, and the infrastructure required to run AI reliably at scale.</li>
<li>Proven experience designing evaluation frameworks, guardrails, or quality systems for AI-driven features.</li>
<li>A track record of setting technical architecture and standards across teams and mentoring senior engineers.</li>
<li>Strong command of a major programming language (e.g., Python, Java, or Go) and modern cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP).</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with agentic systems — designing and hardening AI agents that take autonomous action in production.</li>
<li>Depth in the modern AI stack — retrieval-augmented generation, vector stores, agent frameworks, model orchestration, or evaluation tooling.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>BENEFITS:</strong></p>
<p>For more information about our company's comprehensive benefits please visit: https://salesloftbenefits.com/</p>
<p>At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.</p>
<p>We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.</p>
<p>If you’re excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!</p>
<p>Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Clari + Salesloft will come from&nbsp;@ <a href="http://salesloft.com">salesloft.com</a> email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official <a href="https://salesloft.com/company/careers/">Careers Page</a>.</p>
<p><em>We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, notetaking, or summarizing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment - all hiring decisions are made by people. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or prefer to opt out of any AI-assisted tools, please let your recruiter know. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.</em></p>
<p>#LI-REMOTE</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>It is Salesloft’s intent to pay all Lofters competitive wages and salaries that are motivational, fair and equitable.&nbsp; The goal of Salesloft’s compensation program is to be transparent, attract potential employees, meet the needs of all current employees and encourage employees to stay with our organization.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p>Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location.</p>
<p>The total compensation package for this position may also include performance bonus, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans.&nbsp;</p></div><div class="title">Base Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$165,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$185,000 USD</span></div></div></div>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Thank you for considering Tailscale. <p><strong>About Tailscale&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. <p>We are looking for an Analytics Engineer who thrives in high-complexity environments—someone excited to bring clarity to chaos, untangle complex models, and lay down the foundation for scalable solutions.</p>
<p>This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who isn’t afraid to address manual processes, viewing them as opportunities to build scalable solutions that drive meaningful impact. <li>Ability to manage time, prioritize effectively, and thrive in a fast-moving environment.</li>
<li>Clear communication skills with both technical and non-technical collaborators.</li>
<li>Willingness to flexibly support other domains (e.g., Product, Marketing, and Engineering) as the team grows.</li>
</ul>
<h3><span>Nice to Have</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>Experience at a high-growth PLG SaaS company.</li>
<li>A track record of transforming manual, ad hoc workflows into scalable data pipelines.</li>
<li>Familiarity with billing systems, GAAP accounting, revenue recognition, or audit support.</li>
<li>Exposure to Stripe, Salesforce, or Orb in billing and finance contexts.</li>
<li>Familiarity with financial cycles and the need for fast iteration during month- and quarter-end.</li>
</ul>

<ul>
<li>Snowflake, dbt, Hightouch, Fivetran, Looker, Stripe, Salesforce, Orb.</li>
</ul>

<ul>
<li><strong>An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self.</strong> We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.</li>
<li><strong>A competitive total compensation package.</strong> This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).</li>
<li><strong>Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. </strong>Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!</li>
<li><strong>Remote first company</strong>—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.</li>
<li><strong>Employer-funded retirement contributions. </strong>Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.</li>

</ul>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote 
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.</p>
<p>Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.</p>
<p>We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others.&nbsp;</p>
<p>We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City.&nbsp;</p></div><p>We are hiring a <strong>Senior Software Engineer</strong> for Lithic’s Card Authorization team, which owns the real-time systems that make every card authorization decision correct, reliable, and fast. The team also owns related fraud tooling, including Lithic’s Rules Engine and 3D Secure integration. You’ll own high-impact projects end-to-end, solve distributed-systems problems at scale, and help build the tools customers use to control fraud and payment risk.</p>
<h3><strong>What you'll do:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Write reliable, secure, scalable code for Lithic’s real-time authorization and fraud-prevention systems with minimal tech debt</li>
<li>Build customer-facing features, such as rules improvements, velocity controls, 3DS flows, fraud tooling, and transaction monitoring. Own projects from planning to launch.</li>
<li>Improve the reliability of systems in team’s scope and participate in the team on-call rotation</li>
<li>Lead efforts to improve systems and processes within the team</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>What you'll bring:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>4+ years building production backend systems. Full stack experience is a plus.</li>
<li>Experience in or desire to learn Rust; ability to understand Lithic’s system written in other programming languages (Python, Java)</li>
<li>Interest and experience in leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity</li>
<li>Ability to navigate ambiguity, align diverse perspectives, and drive toward practical solutions</li>
<li>Experience or interest in payments, fintech, fraud prevention.</li>
<li>Comfort with designing systems from scratch and owning the product development process end-to-end</li>
<li>Strong written communication skills and experience working in a remote, async-first team that’s spread across time zones</li>
</ul>
<p>The annual US salary range for this role is $160,000 to $200,000 plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications.&nbsp;</p>
<p>This is a remote position. However, candidates must be located in the United States, Canada (Ontario or British Columbia), Netherlands, Poland, or Czech Republic. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.</p>

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> San Francisco Bay Area (or Remote U.S.)
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: <strong>play video games.</strong> Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.</p></div><p>Discord's Safety ML team builds the machine learning systems that protect 200M+ users. The team's mission is to make Discord a place where people can build genuine friendships without exposure to harm, at a scale where manual review alone can never keep up.</p>
<p>We're looking for a highly technical, hands-on, and mission-driven Engineering Manager to lead our Safety ML team. As the manager responsible for Safety ML, you will own the detection systems that sit between attackers and our users; real-time and batch models for content understanding, account integrity, and platform abuse.</p>
<p><strong>What You'll Be Doing</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Build and lead an exceptional team of highly-engaged ML engineers by hiring, coaching, and instilling a sense of ownership and impact.</li>
<li>Drive the technical vision and roadmap for Safety ML by collaborating with your team and partners across Trust &amp; Safety, Product, Policy, Legal, and Data Science.</li>
<li>Own the end-to-end lifecycle of production safety models: defining new capabilities, measuring performance, and monitoring the operational health of systems that make millions of enforcement decisions per day.</li>
<li>Manage processes and leverage your technical expertise to continually raise the bar and ensure your team delivers extraordinary results.</li>
<li>Partner with Trust &amp; Safety on label quality, golden sets, and automating manual investigations.</li>
<li>Work with other Engineering Managers to continuously improve the Engineering organization and uphold our <a href="https://blog.discordapp.com/the-four-values-of-working-at-discord-90d5b5102cbc">workplace philosophy</a>.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What you should have</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>You have 5+ years of experience as a Machine Learning Engineer, Data Scientist, or Applied Scientist.</li>
<li>You have 3+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager and successfully managed a team of 5+ engineers.</li>
<li>You have hands-on depth in at least one of: abuse/fraud detection, content classification, behavioral modeling, graph-based modeling, or LLM-based classification systems.</li>
<li>You have strong communication skills and the ability to work well cross-functionally.</li>
<li>You thrive in ambiguous environments and get excited about figuring out solutions to complex problems, and then executing on them.</li>
<li>You are a first principles thinker that can work with others to come up with pragmatic solutions.</li>
<li>You have a proven record of shipping ML systems to production at scale.</li>
<li>You are passionate about coaching and leading other engineers, but can roll up your sleeves and get elbow deep in code when needed.</li>
<li>You keep up with the industry trends and continuously identify new technologies to leverage to solve technical problems</li>
</ul>
<p><em><br>The US base salary range for this full-time position is $272,000 to $340,000 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.<br></em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Why Discord?&nbsp;</strong><br><br>Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. <strong>Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!</strong></p>

      <title>ZoomInfo Technologies LLC: Director, Applied AI</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Bethesda, Maryland, United States; Remote-US-MA; Remote-US-MD; Remote-US-WA; Vancouver, Washington, United States; Waltham, Massachusetts, United States
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen–fast.</p></div><div>
<p class="markdown-p">You'll lead the team that builds the intelligence every ZoomInfo AI agent reasons over — what's true about companies and the people in them, how they relate, and what they're buying. This role owns the B2B data graph strategy end to end, blending classical machine learning and data science with LLM and agentic systems, and treating evaluation and inference cost as core disciplines. You'll set the technical bar for a team of senior engineers while staying close to the code, shipping alongside the people you lead.</p>
<p class="markdown-p"><strong class="markdown-strong">What You'll Do</strong></p>
<ul class="markdown-ul">
<li class="markdown-li">You will ship code alongside your team, prototype alone to prove or kill an idea, and review code as a peer, setting how the team uses agentic coding tools with precise specifications and rigorous review.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You will own delivery end-to-end, from problem framing through serving and on-call, including long-tail graph coverage and user memory for agents that separates user-supplied context from system-of-record data.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You will choose the right method for each problem — classical machine learning, language models, or code — for challenges like sparse-company revenue estimation, entity resolution, and semantic intent modeling, deciding on measured evidence and stopping work that won't pay off.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You will define what it takes to claim an agent's output is correct, not just that its run completed, building the evaluation datasets, regression gates, and experiment designs that back those claims.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You will own inference cost, latency, and capacity, including build-versus-buy and distillation decisions, since a model too expensive to run everywhere isn't a result.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You will hire and grow machine learning engineers, data scientists, and research engineers, developing senior engineers into technical leaders.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You will work across product, platform, security, and legal, and present results and their limits to executives, including when a system isn't good enough to launch.</li>
</ul>
<p class="markdown-p"><strong class="markdown-strong">What You Bring</strong></p>
<p class="markdown-p"><em class="markdown-em">Must-Have:</em></p>
<ul class="markdown-ul">
<li class="markdown-li">You have significant experience building production machine learning systems and leading the engineers who build them by shipping alongside them — demonstrated capability matters more than years.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You have a track record of hiring and developing senior machine learning engineers and data scientists against a high bar.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You stay hands-on today: shipping code, building prototypes independently, and using agentic coding tools daily with rigorous review.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You bring deep classical machine learning and data science expertise (supervised learning, feature engineering, statistical inference and experiment design, strong SQL) alongside production LLM and agentic systems, with the judgment to choose between them, including setting an evaluation bar with leakage-safe validation, calibration, and validated LLM judges.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You have a record of cost and capacity decisions for model serving, such as moving a workload from a hosted model to a distilled or self-hosted one, with the savings measured, and you report results to executives with their limits stated, including recommending against a launch.</li>
</ul>
<p class="markdown-p"><em class="markdown-em">Preferred:</em></p>
<ul class="markdown-ul">
<li class="markdown-li">You bring entrepreneurial experience — founding a company, or taking a product from inception to paying customers as a founding or early engineer.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You have experience in propensity modeling, ranking and retrieval, clustering, or entity resolution at scale.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You have worked on web-scale language processing over multilingual, noisy text, knowledge graphs, or user memory for agents.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You have experience with post-training and distillation, open-weight model serving, or AI governance and safety practices (ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF).</li>
</ul>
<p class="markdown-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="markdown-p">#LI-hybrid</p>
<p class="markdown-p">#LI-VC1</p>
</div><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Actual compensation offered will be based on factors such as the candidate’s work location, qualifications, skills, experience and/or training. Your recruiter can share more information about the specific salary range for your desired work location during the hiring process. We want our employees and their families to thrive.</p>

<div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Be Part of Building the Future</strong></h2>
<p>Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&amp;P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. Based on open source technologies, including Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow, Dremio provides an open lakehouse architecture enabling the fastest time to insight and platform flexibility at a fraction of the cost.&nbsp; Learn more at&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="http://www.dremio.com/">www.dremio.com.</a></p></div><p><strong>About the role</strong></p>
<p>In this role you will get opportunities to implement and maintain CI/CD systems and developer productivity solutions. You will be responsible for both regularly scheduled work as well as on-demand break-fix work to support Dremio’s CI/CD system, identifying areas of improvement, and implementing changes to increase efficiency and effectiveness of those systems.</p>
<p>Bring your industry experience to improve the efficiency and scale of Dremio’s infrastructure via innovation on tooling and methodologies. You should have empathy for developers and a passion for engineering productivity.&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Solve problems for fellow Dremio engineers by:</li>
<ul>
<li>Leveraging and contributing to playbooks to implement solutions to unblock them</li>
<li>Identifying short term workarounds and documenting them</li>
<li>Automating processes where manual processes exist.</li>
</ul>
<li>Working on infrastructure across all major clouds (AWS, GCP, Azure).</li>
<li>Managing access to key infrastructure.</li>
<li>Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and associated systems to increase organizational efficiency.</li>
<li>Automate local development workflows.</li>
<li>Analyze performance bottlenecks, root cause issues, file defects, follow up with developers, and document resolutions.</li>
<li>Clear focus on keeping our development branches ‘green’.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Release engineering - automating processes to push software to delivery endpoints.</li>
<li>Report out on the status, reliability and robustness of our CI/CD systems.</li>
<li>Actively participate in code reviews.&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>B.S. or M.S in Computer Science or in a related technical field</li>
<li>1+ years of experience on large scale distributed systems</li>
<li>Comfortable navigating the fast moving, unstructured nature of a hyper-growth startup.</li>
<li>Demonstrable Knowledge and Experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP)</li>
<li>Basic understanding of cloud networking and cloud architecture.</li>
<li>Proficiency in any of Java/C++/Python/Go</li>
<li>Knowledge of Maven or similar build environments</li>
<li>Hands on experience in pipeline automation using CI/CD tools like Jenkins&nbsp;</li>
<li>Experience in Infrastructure as Code</li>
<li>Experience with Terraform, BASH, Docker, Jenkins, and Kubernetes</li>
<li>Ability to write technical reports, effectively summarizing key data</li>
<li>Passion for learning and then delivering solutions using latest technologies</li>
<li>Strong Affinity for collaboration and teamwork</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;<strong>Bonus points if you have</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Working knowledge in data lakes and data warehousing</li>
<li>Proficient with SQL</li>
</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>What we value&nbsp;</strong></h3>

Please click </span></em><a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1CB96QFmOX-bFy48YFOe2GO5lmdawOpKKBj8DpTgsuNg/edit?usp=sharing"><em><span>here</span></em></a><em><span> to review the privacy notice.&nbsp;</span></em></p>

      <title>Dremio: Senior Staff Software Engineer - Query Execution</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Portugal - Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Be Part of Building the Future</strong></h2>
<p>Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&amp;P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. Based on open source technologies, including Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow, Dremio provides an open lakehouse architecture enabling the fastest time to insight and platform flexibility at a fraction of the cost.&nbsp; Learn more at&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="http://www.dremio.com/">www.dremio.com.</a></p></div><p><strong>About the role</strong></p>
<p>Dremio’s Query Execution team builds the runtime responsible for executing analytical queries at scale. The team sits between query planning and table scans, owning the systems that turn query plans into efficient, reliable execution.</p>
<p>As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you’ll work on query operators, expression evaluation, memory management, execution scheduling, runtime planning, and performance optimization. Your work will directly affect query performance, scalability, and reliability across Dremio’s cloud data platform.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Build the execution engine: Design, implement, test, and support query operators, expression evaluation, execution scheduling, runtime planning, and resource management.</li>
<li>Improve runtime performance: Optimize vectorized processing, concurrency, parallelism, memory usage, data exchange, and disk spilling.</li>
<li>Diagnose difficult problems: Investigate query correctness and performance issues using query profiles, profiling tools, telemetry, benchmarks, logs, and production data.</li>
<li>Optimize Java and the JVM: Improve CPU utilization, allocation behavior, garbage collection, thread behavior, and other runtime characteristics.</li>
<li>Collaborate across the query engine: Work with Query Planner, Datalake, Product, Support, and field engineering teams on end-to-end query improvements.</li>
<li>Use AI-assisted development tools: Apply AI tools to code comprehension, debugging, test generation, documentation, and incident analysis.</li>
<li>Apply engineering judgment: Validate AI-generated code and recommendations through review, testing, benchmarking, and engineering judgment.</li>
<li>Raise the engineering bar: Participate in design and code reviews, contribute to technical direction, and mentor other engineers.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Software engineering experience: 5+ years developing production software, preferably in database systems, query execution, distributed systems, or related areas.</li>
<li>Programming skills: Strong Java skills; experience with C++ is a plus.</li>
<li>Computer science fundamentals: Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, concurrency, multithreaded programming, and asynchronous programming.</li>
<li>Database and distributed systems knowledge: Understanding of database internals, query processing, distributed execution, and performance optimization.</li>
<li>Performance engineering experience: Experience profiling and optimizing CPU, memory, garbage collection, thread behavior, or other runtime characteristics.</li>
<li>Problem-solving ability: Ability to solve ambiguous technical problems and work effectively across team boundaries.</li>
<li>Engineering judgment: Ability to evaluate tradeoffs, validate solutions rigorously, and make sound decisions when working with unfamiliar or AI-assisted implementations.</li>
<li>Communication and ownership: Strong communication skills, a sense of ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality software.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

<ul>
<li>Query engines: Distributed query engines, database engines, or large-scale data processing systems.</li>
<li>Execution techniques: Vectorized execution, query operators, expression evaluation, code generation, or runtime optimization.</li>
<li>Runtime systems: JVM profiling, memory management, caching, networking, data exchange, execution scheduling, or disk spilling.</li>
<li>Data platforms: Apache Arrow, Apache Iceberg, Parquet, Avro, Spark, Hadoop, or cloud object stores.</li>

</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>What we value&nbsp;</strong></h3>

      <title>Toggl: Senior Full Stack</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0074/7274/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Tallinn, Estonia
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://toggl.com/jobs/">https://toggl.com/jobs/</a>
</p>

<div class="_descriptionText_5yu8i_201 ashby-job-posting-description">
<p>We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join one of our Product Tribes, the cross-functional units that own the end-to-end experience for a specific Toggl user role. You'll join the Tribe building for managers, the people who plan work, protect margins, and keep projects on time and on budget.</p>
<p>You own significant parts of that experience end-to-end, working hands-on with product and design to ship work that matters. You'll do this as we build and launch Toggl 2.0, our consolidated planning, time tracking, and time intelligence product.</p>
<p>The salary for this position is&nbsp;<strong>€83,000 annually.</strong></p>
<p>You can work from anywhere in the world&nbsp;<strong>as long as your main location is between UTC-4 and UTC+4.</strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2><strong>The Role</strong></h2>
<p>As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you own meaningful parts of the product end-to-end, from the data model and the API to the interface someone actually clicks: the technical approach, the quality of what ships, and whether it actually works for the people using it. You are accountable not for tickets closed, but for clarity, craft, and outcomes.</p>
<p>You'll work in the Tribe serving managers, across planning and capacity management, dashboards, and billable work. This is some of the most data-dense, interaction-heavy surface area in the product: schedules and capacity views, reports, and visualizations that have to stay fast and readable at real customer scale. The interesting problems live on both sides of the API here - the query behind a capacity view matters as much as how that view renders. You'll build with React and TypeScript on the frontend and our backend services (mostly Golang) and data layer (Postgres) behind them, alongside a product manager, a designer, and engineers who are used to owning their work and pushing back when something isn't right. In a tribe of 5 other engineers, your impact and visibility are high.</p>
<p>Our team meetings are scheduled between 11:00 and 16:00 UTC. Your availability and commitment to participate in these sessions are essential for effective collaboration and team alignment.</p>
<p>Your main responsibilities will be:</p>
<p><strong>Ownership and delivery</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Take projects from problem to production. Own the technical approach for major features front to back, break the work down sensibly, sequence it, and ship in slices rather than one big drop.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Make the technical calls in your area. Choose between options, name the tradeoffs, and decide without waiting for permission or escalating routine judgment.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Keep your work visible without being chased. Flag risks and slips early, keep the Tribe in the loop, and unblock yourself.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Craft and quality across the stack</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Build interfaces people trust with dense, real-world data. Planning views, dashboards, and reports that stay fast, accessible, and readable when the dataset gets ugly.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Design the data and API layer those views depend on. Model it so the feature you're building now doesn't make the next three harder.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Own performance as a feature, end to end. Profile, measure, and fix the slow query and the slow render instead of hoping the data stays small.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Write code others can work in. Sensible components and services, real test coverage where it earns its keep, and a codebase that's easier to change after you touch it.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Working with product and design</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Shape solutions, don't just implement them. Push on the problem, question requirements that don't hold up, and propose simpler paths when you see one.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Partner closely with design. Prototype early, spot the edge cases in a flow before it's built, and hold the bar on UX quality with your designer rather than after handoff.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Stay close to users and evidence. Join user tests, read the feedback, look at the data, and let it change what you build.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Raising the bar</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Review code with intent. Give precise, actionable feedback that makes the change and the person better.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Mentor and interview. Help other engineers grow, and help us hire well.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Improve things across team boundaries. Spot shared components and duplicated work between Tribes, and raise it before we build the same thing twice.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>AI as core leverage</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Use AI tools extensively in your daily work for exploration, prototyping, code generation and review, debugging, research, and writing. AI fluency is not optional. It's part of how you increase your speed, depth, and impact - and you're expected to help the rest of the Tribe get better at it too.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2><strong>About You</strong></h2>
<p>You will thrive in this role if you:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Have significant experience building and shipping production web applications end to end, and can lead major projects rather than just contribute to them.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Are genuinely comfortable on both sides of the stack. You're deep on one side and properly capable on the other, not someone who hands off at the API boundary.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Have deep, practical knowledge of&nbsp;<strong>JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and modern CSS</strong>&nbsp;- including state management and side-effect handling in large applications.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Are solid on backend fundamentals: at least one backend language you know well, API design, relational data modelling, and enough instinct for query performance to spot the problem before production does.&nbsp;<strong>Prior Golang experience is not mandatory but you have to be willing to adopt it and become comfortable with it fast.</strong></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Hold an extremely high bar for quality. You know what great looks like, you notice the details others miss, and you don't ship work you wouldn't put your name on.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Have a knack for data-heavy product surfaces - performance, readability, and the principles behind a chart that actually communicates something.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Care about the user's problem, not just the ticket. You start from what someone is trying to get done and work back to the implementation.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Own outcomes, not output. You follow your work into production, watch how it behaves, and fix what needs fixing.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You make confident decisions with incomplete information, adapt when things change, and course-correct without drama.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Are hands-on with AI tools. You actively use AI as a core part of how you build, not a side experiment, and you have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Don't need to be managed. You set your own direction, keep people in the loop, and ask for help when it matters.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Have excellent written and verbal English communication skills. You write clearly, explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineers without jargon, and default to async communication that others can follow.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Are eager to contribute to the engineering team's growth - code review, mentoring, and interviewing included.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Value transparency, ownership, and speed over perfection. You ship, learn, and improve rather than waiting for the perfect plan.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Nice to have:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Experience with TanStack is a bonus, and so is a real understanding of frontend caching and eventual consistency, we'd love to hire someone who's dealt with that tradeoff directly.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience with capacity planning, scheduling, reporting, or other complex B2B SaaS products.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience working with distributed or microservice systems, a basic understanding of infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and some experience creating, improving, or debugging CI/CD pipelines.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>This Role Is NOT</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>A ticket-taker role. If you want fully specced work handed to you, this isn't the right fit.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A pixel-pusher translating finished designs into code with no say in the problem or the solution.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A role where you hand off at the API boundary. If "that's a backend ticket" is your instinct, this will frustrate you.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A role where quality is someone else's job. Toggl doesn't have a dedicated QA<br>team or layer: there's no separate team that will catch your bugs, write your<br>tests, or own your performance regressions.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A place to work in isolation from users. You'll be expected to know who you're building for and why.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A role for people who need heavy process, frequent approvals, or top-down direction to do their best work.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>The Team</strong></p>
<p>We are a global team of ~80 awesome people working from over 40 countries around the globe. We hire globally, you work locally—in the heart of London, a beach outside of Río de Janeiro, or a quiet village near Florence, the choice is yours. Every few months we travel to meet up somewhere in the world and spend some quality time together. We place a huge amount of trust in our people, and we measure the outcomes rather than the work itself.&nbsp;<a href="https://toggl.com/culture/">Our values</a>&nbsp;fuel our results.<br><br><strong>What's Happening at Toggl</strong></p>
<p>Toggl is at an exciting turning point. We're taking our best-in-class time tracking - trusted and loved by millions of users worldwide - and expanding it into something bigger:&nbsp;<a href="https://toggl.com/focus/">Toggl 2.0</a>. One product that brings together time tracking, planning, capacity management, reporting, and insight. The idea is simple: better time tracking creates better data, which powers everything else. We call it time intelligence. We build with AI throughout, and we think it's a real multiplier for strong engineers rather than a substitute for them. The judgment, the tradeoffs, and the accountability for what ships stay with people.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Benefits</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Freedom to choose when and how much you work—we only measure results</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>24 days of paid time off a year, plus your local holidays</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Unlimited sick leave</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>In-person meetups for team-building (expenses covered)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>4-6 weeks paid sabbatical (depending on tenure)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Laptop budget up to 2,500€ and it renews every 3 years</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>€2,000 budget to set up your home office and an additional €300 every year after 3 years of tenure</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>€3,000 per year for co-working space membership and/or internet service at home</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>€4,000 per year contribution to use for training, workshops, and conferences</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>€2,400 per year contribution for any equipment or services to improve and/or maintain your physical and mental health</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Support for buying tools you need for doing your best work (even eyeglasses if you need a new pair)</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toggl-senior-full-stack">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toggl-senior-full-stack</a></p>
</description>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>

      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6433/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Minnesota
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://www.steuartnutrition.com/">https://www.steuartnutrition.com/</a>
</p>

<p><strong>About us</strong></p>
<p>Steuart Nutrition is a GMP-certified contract manufacturer making powders, liquids, capsules and stick packs for growing wellness brands. We run on Extreme Ownership, clear communication and fast turnaround, and we want a developer who works the same way.</p>
<p><strong>The role</strong></p>
<p>We're hiring a remote developer to own the customization of our training app. You'll learn the platform quickly, then build what our teams need to train and onboard people. Over time you'll also take on other internal tools and automations. AI-assisted development is central to how we work, so we want someone who uses AI tools to write and ship better code faster.</p>
<p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Learn our training app inside and out, then customize and extend it</li>
<li>Build features, integrations and automations with AI coding tools like Claude, Cursor, Copilot and Grok</li>
<li>Turn rough requests from the plant and office teams into working solutions</li>
<li>Document your work so others can use it and maintain it</li>
<li>Give regular, clear progress updates</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What we're looking for</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>3+ years of professional software development</li>
<li>Strong, proven skill with AI-assisted coding: you know how to prompt, check and fix AI-generated code</li>
<li>A track record of quickly learning unfamiliar platforms and codebases</li>
<li>Experience with APIs, web apps and integrations (JavaScript/TypeScript or Python preferred)</li>
<li>Excellent written English and consistent communication</li>
<li>Able to overlap at least 4 hours a day with US Eastern Time</li>
<li>Bonus: experience with LMS or training platforms, or with manufacturing or regulated industries</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/steuart-nutrition-software-developer-ai-coding">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/steuart-nutrition-software-developer-ai-coding</a></p>

Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. Spotify is expanding our Agency development team dedicated to driving new and innovative strategic partnerships with our largest agency partners in France. You will showcase all the technological and data assets available to drive business goals.

The Agency Development Lead will own strategic agency partnerships across the French market. This is not an account management role — you'll architect the agency relationships and commercial frameworks which create opportunities for the FR sales team to activate. You bring deep experience in partnership development and senior agency relationships at the holding company level, with an established track record of building long-term consultative solutions and innovative ways of working with agencies which create value for advertisers.  You have a passion for digital media, music, podcasts and innovation, and you know how to translate that into commercial strategy.

  • Advocate internally for the needs of independent creators and publishers, helping shape future product capabilities and strategic initiatives.
  • Contribute to initiatives focused on catalog expansion, subscriber value, listening growth, operational excellence, and blended cost per content hour (CPCH) optimization.

    At Spotify, we are redefining the audiobook industry with our innovative Audiobooks in Premium model. Our mission is to empower creators and consumers by delivering the best audiobook content with unmatched quality and accessibility. We are building a thriving ecosystem that scales with creativity, collaboration, and innovative technology.

    We’re building Spotify’s audiobook business in Japan and looking for someone to lead our relationships with Japanese publishers.     Every dataset at Spotify, from the data behind creator royalties to the signals powering recommendations, is registered, published and traced through systems our team builds. We're the source of truth for what data exists at Spotify, where it lives, who owns it, and how it flows from one pipeline to the next.

    These systems sit on the critical path of the platform. Data teams use them every day to publish and find data, and other platform teams build on them for access, retention, governance and incident response. That means our work is judged on correctness and reliability, because every system built on top of ours is only as good as the metadata we provide.

    This is a backend role focused on data management, working on the problems at the core of any large data platform: running a data catalog that stays accurate at scale, capturing lineage across batch and streaming workloads, managing schemas as they evolve, and guaranteeing that consumers only read complete data. We build on open standards like OpenLineage and Apache Iceberg, and define the internal standards for naming, storage and metadata that the rest of Spotify builds against. As the platform takes on new storage technologies and new kinds of data assets, those standards and the systems behind them have to evolve with it, and you'll help decide how.

     

    ","id":"186b763a-2a61-4563-8813-ff6b40c9c8a7","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"
  • Build and Evolve Core Services: Design, build and operate the backend services and APIs behind our data catalog, lineage and publishing systems, and evolve them as the platform adopts new storage technologies and new kinds of data. Hold them to a high bar for correctness, performance and reliability.
  • Build Data Pipelines: Develop and run the batch and streaming pipelines that keep our metadata current, processing platform events and audit logs to capture how data is created and changed, and turning lineage and metadata into data products other teams build on.
  • Own Projects End to End: Turn what the teams using our platform need into technical designs, drive them through delivery and rollout, and own the results once they're in production.
  • Keep the Platform Healthy: Take part in on-call for critical services, build in observability and quality checks by default, and use automation, including AI tooling, to reduce toil for the team and our users.

    We're looking for an Engineering Manager II to lead a team of data and backend engineers within our Subscriptions Mission.     ","id":"9eeb10f9-6b63-4113-95dd-137519120084","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"

    • Lead, support, and develop a team of data and backend engineers, creating an inclusive environment where everyone can contribute and grow.

    • Work with product managers, business partners, and engineering teams to set priorities and build data products that improve the subscription experience.

    • Guide the development of reliable, scalable data pipelines and backend services that support targeting, messaging, personalisation, and machine learning.

    • Help your team make informed technical decisions, balancing data quality, reliability, business needs, and long-term maintainability.

    • Support engineers through regular feedback, coaching, career development, and opportunities to share knowledge.

    • Collaborate across teams to manage dependencies, solve challenges, and build shared data solutions.

    • Improve engineering practices, including service reliability, sustainable on-call processes, and responsible data management.

    • Explore opportunities to use AI and automation to simplify workflows, improve data quality, and support your team's work.

    "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"

    • You have experience leading data or backend engineering teams and enjoy helping engineers develop their skills and careers.

    • You have a background in software or data engineering and can guide technical discussions about data architecture, distributed systems, scalability, and reliability.

    • You understand how to balance team development, technical decisions, and delivery priorities to achieve meaningful results.

    • You have worked with large-scale data pipelines, data platforms, or backend services. Experience with technologies such as Google Cloud, BigQuery, Apache Beam, Dataflow, dbt, Flyte, Airflow, Scala, or Java is valuable.

    • You can navigate changing priorities, make informed decisions, and help your team move forward when the path isn't always clear.

    • You communicate clearly and build effective partnerships with product, business, and engineering teams to turn shared goals into practical solutions.

    • You value different perspectives, encourage open feedback, and help create an environment where people feel respected and supported.

    • You're curious about new technologies, including AI and automation, and enjoy finding ways to improve how teams work and deliver value.

    With scale comes complexity. You will focus on tackling payment fraud, chargebacks/disputes, creator onboarding and platform misuse that risks revenue leakage and partner trust.

    ","id":"5992c673-e493-48b1-bb63-9b82a4c31876","lists":[{"text":"What You’ll Do","content":"

  • Detection & Mitigation: Review suspicious activity flagged by our fraud systems and take swift mitigating and preventative action to protect our genuine users, secure our growth, and minimize revenue leakage.

  • AI & Tooling Innovation: Actively utilize, test, and adopt emerging AI technologies and automated tooling to enhance fraud detection and improve operational productivity.

  • Build & Optimize: Partner closely with internal Product and Engineering teams as well as external vendors to help contribute to the design, requirement gathering, and testing of tooling and system changes to capture evolving fraud and abuse trends early.

  • Trend Analysis & Investigation: Be creative and proactively seek out new fraud and misuse trends. Present data-informed findings and retrospectives to suggest robust performance guardrails.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Handle daily fraud and misuse escalations while working closely with Data Science, Engineering, and Product teams to translate operational insights into risk mitigation frameworks.

  • Operational Excellence: Support the Revenue Protection leadership in maintaining and improving internal policies, process automation, evidence handling, and operational playbooks.

    • "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"

  • Experience: 2+ years of experience in a fraud analyst or revenue protection role, preferably within an e-commerce, merchant fraud, or creator & marketplace platform environment. Given the fixed-term nature of this role, the ability to rapidly adapt and hit the ground running is highly valued.

  • Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with common fraud prevention techniques, dispute/chargeback management, financial crime risks, and emerging industry trends.

  • AI & Systems Mindset: Direct experience working with machine learning and rule-based fraud prevention tooling (such as Ravelin, Sift, Signifyd, Accertify, etc.). You possess the confidence and curiosity to leverage AI technologies to test, scale, and optimize internal fraud detection tools.

  • Data Proficiency: Strong data analysis skills using SQL (knowledge of Google BigQuery is a plus) and experience with dashboard visualization tools like Looker, Tableau, or similar.

  • Analytical Thinker: An ambitious and creative problem solver who works well independently, thrives when handling ambiguity, and can break down complex technical risks into practical applications.

  • Collaborator & Communicator: A highly communicative person with a collaborative mindset who excels at building strong relationships with internal stakeholders, operations, and global partners.

    Spotify's in-house creative studio, Reverb, brings our brand to life through thoughtful design, visual storytelling, and creative production. Working across brand and communications, the team creates work that connects with audiences around the world.

    We're looking for a Global Creative Lead to shape the visual direction of Reverb and lead a talented team of graphic designers, motion designers, and producers. You'll combine creative vision with hands-on leadership, helping the team deliver distinctive, high-quality work while building an environment where people can collaborate, experiment, and grow.

    Reporting to the Director, Global Experiential & Content Production, you'll play a key role in shaping the studio's creative output and how we work together.

    ","id":"25fac63d-d4ba-48b9-80b1-b8e87b55e448","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"
  • Lead and develop a team of approximately 5–6 graphic designers, motion designers, and producers, supporting their creative growth and career development.

    • Shape the visual and motion design direction across Reverb projects, creating distinctive work that brings Spotify's brand and stories to life.

    • Partner with teams across brand, communications, marketing, and production to turn creative briefs into engaging visual experiences across channels and formats.

    • Guide creative development from concept through delivery, providing clear direction, constructive feedback, and thoughtful design decisions.

    • Manage project intake, priorities, budgets, timelines, and resources to help the team deliver meaningful work across multiple projects.

    • Collaborate with Reverb's creative and production leads to build a connected, effective studio and a consistent creative experience.

    • Present creative concepts and recommendations to senior stakeholders, explaining the thinking behind decisions and building alignment.

    • Work with internal teams and external creative partners to maintain design quality, manage production needs, and navigate relevant legal and licensing requirements.

    "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"

    • You bring 8+ years of experience in graphic design, visual design, or a related creative discipline, with a portfolio demonstrating strong visual storytelling, brand identity, and motion design.

    • You have 4+ years of experience leading creative teams, with a thoughtful approach to coaching, feedback, and helping others develop their craft.

    • You're comfortable shaping creative direction across digital, social, advertising, editorial, and long-form brand content, adapting your approach to different audiences and formats.

    • You have experience using Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma, and relevant visual or motion design tools, and you're curious about how emerging technologies can support the creative process.

    • You know how to balance creative ambition with practical delivery, making thoughtful decisions around timelines, budgets, and resources.

    As Legal Counsel, Litigation, you will work on a variety of litigation, copyright, patent, and other contentious and advisory matters, and help craft the way our company thinks about and handles them.     ","id":"8d54dd6d-d7e0-4298-b051-423bcec4089e","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"
  • Coordinate litigation, pre-litigation, regulatory, and other dispute matters across multiple practice areas, including copyright and patent litigation.
  • Work with outside counsel to develop case strategy, manage budgets, and drive efficient resolution of contentious disputes.
  • Partner with the business on litigation and legal risk issues and work with colleagues to fashion solutions that balance legal risk with company objectives.
  • Develop litigation case strategies, work closely with Spotify's communications team, and formulate plans to resolve disputes efficiently.
  • Plan strategically and coordinate internally with legal and non-legal personnel on issues of the moment.
  • Provide proactive advice to internal team members on dispute avoidance and resolution, including risk mitigation.
  • Identify and mitigate threats against the company, whether from partners, users, content owners, or others.
  • Handle requests for information from the company, including subpoenas and requests from law enforcement.
  • Build scalable processes to address a growing number of claims across copyright, patent, and other areas.
  • Train teams and draft workflows and policies to help establish effective internal risk mitigation procedures.
  • Stay current on developments in patent and copyright law, particularly as they affect the technology and media industries.

    We are seeking Research Scientists (across all levels of seniority) to join our Artist-First AI Music Lab. Our team pioneers and advances state-of-the-art generative technologies for music that create breakthrough experiences for fans and artists. We invent entirely new listening experiences that center and celebrate artists and creatives. All of our products will put artists and songwriters first, through these four principles:

    • Partnerships with record labels, distributors, and music publishers: We’ll develop new products for artists and fans through upfront agreements, not by asking for forgiveness later.
    • Choice in participation: We recognize there’s a wide range of views on the use of generative music tools within the artistic community. Therefore, artists and rightsholders will choose if and how to participate to ensure the use of AI tools aligns with the values of the people behind the music.
    • Fair compensation and new revenue: We will build products that create wholly new revenue streams for rightsholders, artists, and songwriters, ensuring they are properly compensated for the use of their work and transparently credited for their contributions.
    • Artist-fan connection: AI tools we develop will not replace human artistry. They will give artists new ways to be creative and connect with fans. We will leverage our role as the place where more than 700 million people already come to listen to music every month to ensure that generative AI deepens artist-fan connections.

    Learn more in our press release: https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-10-16/artist-first-ai-music-spotify-collaboration/

    ","id":"0eebb462-b5a2-4e3a-b830-d8ef7505b014","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"
    Conduct groundbreaking research in generative audio using diffusion or flow matching models, with a focus on one or more of the following areas:
     
    Vocal Synthesis — Research in vocal and speech synthesis, along with related areas such as ML-based audio processing and signal processing.
     
    Post-Training — Research in post-training techniques for music generation, including preference alignment methods (such as DPO, RLHF, or KTO), reward model design and training, and reinforcement learning to improve output quality, controllability, and human preference adherence.
     
    Editing — Research in iterative music generation and audio editing, including capabilities such as stem replacement, instrumentation change, mood changes (while preserving content), tempo changes, and structure changes.
     
    You will also:
  • Run large-scale experiments with access to Spotify's extensive infrastructure and an audience of more than 700 million monthly active users.
  • Create practical applications that harness generative technologies and push the boundaries of what's possible in listening experiences.
  • Collaborate as part of a cross-functional team—working closely with scientists, engineers, product managers, designers, user researchers, and analysts—to craft innovative solutions to complex challenges.
  • Have a direct impact on Spotify's products, tools, and services, working on projects that influence the entire organization.
  • Engage with the broader research community by publishing your findings, delivering talks, and attending top conferences.
    • "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"
  • You have a Ph.D. in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field. Previous industry experience is helpful.
  • You have experience in one or more of the following fields: generative modeling, machine learning, music information retrieval, speech processing, audio processing, signal processing, probabilistic modeling, computer vision, or related areas.
  • You have deep expertise in at least one of the focus areas above—whether that's vocal/speech synthesis, post-training alignment techniques (e.g., PPO, GRPO, DPO), or audio-to-audio generation and text-guided music editing.
  • You have publications at leading conferences such as ICASSP, ISMIR, INTERSPEECH, ICLR, AAAI, IJCAI, NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, ECCV, ICCV, or related venues.
  • You have strong coding skills in Python, PyTorch, and NumPy.
  • You are a creative problem solver who is passionate about building outstanding products that add real value to millions of people.
  • You are enthusiastic about turning research ideas into products operating at scale.
  • You can explain complex topics in simple terms, and you enjoy building strong relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.

We will leverage our role as the place where more than 700 million people already come to listen to music every month to ensure that generative AI deepens artist-fan connections.

We will leverage our role as the place where more than 700 million people already come to listen to music every month to ensure that generative AI deepens artist-fan connections.

    The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

     

    Security engineers at Spotify protect our platform, employees, creators, and more than 700 million users. We are looking for an experienced Security Engineer to join the Detection and Response organization and help identify, investigate, and respond to threats across Spotify's environment.

     

    You will work within our detection engineering squad where the team owns alert triage, security investigations, threat hunting, and the detection engineering lifecycle. You will turn threat intelligence, incident learnings, and analyst feedback into effective detections and investigation workflows. You will partner closely with the detection infrastructure squad, which builds and operates Detection and Response platforms and telemetry pipelines, and with teams across Spotify to make sure your squad has the signals and capabilities needed to detect and respond to threats at Spotify's scale.

     

    We are a distributed team that values curiosity, sound judgment, clear communication, and continuous learning. We teach and learn from one another, adapt as the threat landscape changes, and focus our effort according to business needs and risk.

    ","id":"cb29d857-395b-401d-9749-367e666ff870","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"

    • Identify detection opportunities, define clear telemetry requirements, and partner with the detection infrastructure squad and data owners to make the signals needed for detection and investigation available.

    • Develop, test, tune, and maintain detections across endpoint, identity, cloud, SaaS, email, and other security-relevant environments.

    • Investigate and prioritize alerts, determine their security impact, and participate in incident containment and remediation.

    • Build repeatable investigation workflows and playbooks for alert triage, evidence collection, decision-making, escalation, containment, and response.

    • Improve proactive threat-identification and threat-hunting capabilities using internal telemetry and external threat intelligence.

    • Create cutting-edge AI workflows for Detection and Response that enrich alerts, gather and analyze evidence, guide investigations, and automate repetitive response work while preserving appropriate human judgment and oversight.

    • Measure detection effectiveness, identify coverage gaps, and tune detections to balance security value, fidelity, and analyst workload.

    • Use SIEM, EDR, SOAR, and related security platforms to research threats, develop detections, investigate alerts, and validate security outcomes.

    • Share knowledge, document decisions, and communicate security findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

    "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"

    • You are curious, collaborative, and comfortable making progress in an ambiguous and rapidly changing environment.

    • You have 3+ years of hands-on experience in security operations, incident response, threat detection, detection engineering, or closely related work.

    • You understand how analysts triage and investigate alerts and how detection quality affects their decisions and workload.

    • You know how to create and tune detections based on attacker behavior, available telemetry, and an expected investigation path.

    • You are experienced with security platforms such as SIEM, EDR, SOAR, or comparable monitoring and response technologies.

    • You can write code or use an automation platform to analyze security telemetry, enrich alerts, build investigation workflows, and remove repetitive work. Experience with Python or a similar language is valuable.

    • You understand modern detection-as-code practices, including GitHub, peer review, CI/CD, testing, and safely managing production detection content.

    • You have experience working with at least one major cloud platform, such as Google Cloud, AWS, or Azure.

    • You understand common threats affecting SaaS-oriented corporate and production environments.

    • You care about clear documentation, inclusive collaboration, and explaining security concepts to people with different backgrounds and levels of expertise.

    • You are excited to create and critically evaluate cutting-edge AI workflows for detection development, alert triage, security investigations, and response, while applying sound security judgment and appropriate human oversight.

    "},{"text":"Where You'll Be","content":"

    • This role is based in New York

    We’re looking for a Senior C++/iOS Engineer to join the Baldur squad within User Platform (UP). Baldur owns Spotify’s Session Management and Delegated Authorization domains—the systems that enable applications to securely obtain, use, and manage access tokens for hundreds of millions of users. In this role, you’ll help shape the technology that powers secure access across every Spotify client and third-party integration. 

    Your work will support engineers across Spotify building mobile and desktop experiences, platform teams, and third-party developers integrating with Spotify’s authorization platform. You’ll collaborate across disciplines to build secure, reliable, and scalable authentication experiences that have a direct impact on millions of people every day.

    ","id":"813b4b62-429c-42e9-a8f7-59e9412fb287","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do ","content":"
  • Collaborate with a highly autonomous and supportive engineering squad responsible for Spotify’s delegated authorization and session management platforms.
  • Design, build, and evolve critical infrastructure powering Spotify applications and partner integrations using shared C++ libraries and native Swift on iOS.
  • Develop secure, reliable, and performant delegated authorization flows, including token issuance, refresh, revocation, and session lifecycle management across multiple platforms.
  • Partner with client and backend engineers to integrate with core authorization services, token issuance, client registration, and token revocation.
  • Improve how credentials and access tokens are securely stored and managed on-device while balancing security, reliability, and application performance.
  • Contribute to the evolution of Spotify’s authorization frameworks, Spotify-specific implementations, enabling new platforms and product experiences.
  • Drive technical improvements, share knowledge with teammates, and help shape the long-term technical direction of delegated authorization and session management.
    • "},{"text":"Who You Are ","content":"
  • You have strong proficiency in C++, along with experience building native iOS applications in Swift, or you're excited to develop your expertise in Swift while applying your C++ skills.
  • You have experience designing, building, or maintaining security-sensitive systems such as authorization, authentication, token management, credential storage, or related platforms.
  • You bring a systems-thinking mindset and enjoy solving complex engineering challenges that span client and backend technologies.
  • You have a solid understanding of software architecture, secure system design, and modern authorization protocols such as OAuth 2.0.
  • You approach problems thoughtfully, with strong attention to detail and a focus on building secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions.
  • You communicate clearly and enjoy collaborating with engineers across multiple teams and technical disciplines.
  • You have experience working with shared cross-platform codebases and understand how native platform layers interact with common C++ libraries.
  • You enjoy working on large-scale distributed systems where your contributions improve experiences for hundreds of millions of Spotify users.
